svg.title: From the docker command to a running process
svg.desc: The docker CLI is only a client: it turns commands such as docker run, build, and ps into REST API calls sent over the Unix socket /var/run/docker.sock, and it can also talk to a remote engine. dockerd, the Docker Engine daemon, manages images, BuildKit builds, networks, volumes, and the API, and delegates containers to containerd over gRPC. containerd pulls, unpacks, and stores images and supervises containers; the Kubernetes kubelet calls containerd directly through the CRI. containerd starts one containerd-shim-runc-v2 process per container, which stays the container's parent and holds its stdio and exit status so the daemons can restart safely. The shim hands runc an OCI bundle, a config.json plus a root filesystem. runc, the OCI runtime, creates the namespaces and cgroups, applies the configuration, starts the process, and exits. The result is your process, for example node dist/server.js, running as PID 1 inside its namespaces with its cgroup limits.
